verdict.rationale: Fly.io is a cloud platform, so user-defined event-driven automation rules are a fair axis, but the evidence shows no product feature for defining rules that trigger actions on events. The closest items are adjacent fixed behaviors: the Machine restart policy (restart after process exit), Sprites waking on request, and automatic Postgres failover. None lets a user author general event→action rules, and a community member notes even cron-like scheduling is missing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
